A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''smuggler''' was present in the [[Jedi Colony]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] around the start of the [[Third Galactic War|third war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
